column1: # MANIFEST. One row per authored file: which tree, path, bytes, SHA-256.
# SIGN THIS FILE INSTEAD OF THE CORPUS. One signature over a list of digests covers
# every byte the list names, and it stays one deliberate act by a person.
# Signing every file separately multiplies attestations without adding
# information, and turns a human attestation into a build step.
# Then anchor the signature: `ots stamp manifest.tsv.asc`. The signature says
# who and the anchor says when, and neither answers the other's question.
# KEEP THIS FILE PRIVATE WHILE THE WORK IS WITHHELD. The anchor is over a digest and
# discloses nothing; this file names paths and therefore does.
